**Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant Application**

**To:** Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant Committee

**From:** Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC)
**Date:** October 26, 2023
**Subject:** Grant Request for Gun Safety Education Initiatives

Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC), a minority-owned social enterprise, respectfully requests between **$15,000 - $20,000** from the Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant to significantly expand our critical gun safety education programs in communities of color.

**The Urgent Need:** Gun violence disproportionately impacts communities of color in Sacramento, particularly along the Stockton Blvd corridor. A lack of culturally relevant and accessible gun safety resources leaves many families vulnerable, contributing to accidental shootings and escalating community concerns.

**Our Innovative Programs:** GAFC directly addresses this need through a multi-faceted approach. Our "Gloxsie 21" cartoon IP engages youth by making complex safety topics relatable and memorable. We host vital community workshops, partnered with the respected Church of Legacy, offering practical, hands-on training on safe gun handling, storage, and conflict de-escalation. We also integrate AI education to empower participants with valuable tech skills, fostering broader community engagement and digital literacy alongside safety awareness.

**Projected Outcomes:** With your support, GAFC will double our workshop capacity, reaching an additional 500 residents within the next year. We anticipate a measurable 30% increase in safe gun storage practices and a heightened understanding of responsible firearm ownership among participants, directly contributing to fewer accidental shootings and a safer environment for families along Stockton Blvd.

**Why GAFC is Uniquely Qualified:** As a minority-owned social enterprise, GAFC possesses unparalleled cultural competency and community trust. Our authentic connection, innovative educational tools, and established partnership with the Church of Legacy enable us to effectively reach and educate vulnerable populations where traditional methods often fail.

This grant will empower GAFC to save lives and foster a more informed, safer Sacramento. Thank you for considering our vital work.
